question: The 23rd FIFA World Cup Football will be jointly organised by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Canada, USA and Mexico**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 23rd FIFA World Cup (2026) will be jointly organized by **Canada, Mexico, and the United States**.
 
• This will be the **first time the tournament is hosted by three countries**
 
• **It **also marks the **first time since 1994** that the event is returning to North America.
 
• The 2026 World Cup will feature **48 teams**, an increase from the 32 teams that have participated in previous tournaments.
 
• The d**ecision to expand the tournament** was made to allow more countries to compete and make the event even more inclusive.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **FIFA World Cu**p, often called the World Cup, is an international association football competition among the senior men's national teams of the members of the Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA),** the sport's global governing body. **
 
• **T**he tournament has been held every four years since the inaugural tournament in 1930, with the exception of 1942 and 1946 due to the Second World War.
 
• The reigning champions are Argentina, **who won their third title at the 2022 tournament by defeating France.**
 
• After FIFA was founded in 1904, it tried to arrange an international football tournament between nations outside the Olympic framework in Switzerland in 1906
